Description: Listen to various parts of a melody, create your own parts, and arrange them in a specific way. Tags: 29-buttons, sounds, music, notes, keys, melody, harmony
Name: Melody Sequencer

Souvenir.Explanation: You do not need to know specifically which slots contained which parts at the start. The only thing that matters is what the parts actually are, then you move them to the correct slots. The parts could've came from anywhere and the answer would still be the same.
